item: row 367: the Governments and Law tabs follow a language switch
summary: Ten app-gov-law.js renderers held through ooLive/ooLiveHtml: the loading and failure lines of Countries, Compare, Aggregates, Groups and the map; the map's Latest available year, redrawn with the picked year still selected; the Law pointer and its hover; and the busy words of Load standard country data (progress kept as numbers), Summarize this change and Add & track (robots words drawn at each draw), each button released to its own label when the work ends. Consent order unchanged. Driven as real code, 19 mutations all caught.
